title: Connected monodromy torsor trivializing a finite locally constant sheaf of sets
statement: Let U be a nonempty connected scheme [def-weil-connected-scheme] and F a finite locally constant sheaf of sets on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. There are a finite group Q in Type u and a connected finite etale ULift(Q)-torsor c:Y -> U [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois] such that the set inverse image c^{-1}F is constant [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Empty F is allowed.

proof.text: Use exists_finiteEtale_flc_equivalence to represent F by P and obtain an isomorphism from the representable sheaf to F. Choose the algebraic closure of the residue field at a point of the connected nonempty U.

Mathlib PreGaloisCategory.exists_galois_representative applied to P supplies a Galois A, a point a of its fibre, and bijective evaluation Hom_U(A,P) -> P_s. The finite-etale Galois category identifies A with a connected scheme. Its finite automorphism group Q lives already in Type u. Transport its action along MulEquiv.ulift. The automorphisms act simply transitively on every fibre point; isIso_sigmaDesc_of_existsUnique therefore constructs the required GaloisCover.

The representable pullback comparison lemma proves constancy on A from bijective evaluation. Transport this constancy along the pullback of the representable-sheaf isomorphism. This includes the empty fibre: no map A -> P is needed in constructing the Galois representative.

proof_origin.note: Galois representative of the finite etale representative; its automorphism group acts simply transitively on the fibre, and the coproduct-of-sections argument identifies the pullback with a constant sheaf.
